notes: Not checker-run: I have no shell, so all figures are hand-worked. Next owner: run `bun tools/plan/cli.ts`. Send T-, S- and N- rule failures back to Vantage, or to Datum if the fix needs geometry.

Critic fix: S1/harbour now fronts harbour-road, not crown-parade. Its 50 m platform runs from x 307 to 357. The west end is over Harbour Road (x 288–312), so the entrance stair lands on that road's east footway, next to T2/parade (309, 10). Position and spacing are unchanged. If Datum wants the entrance on the quay (x 312–330), the quay needs an id first (via Aster).

S1 Skyport is still held. At about x 535 it is over water, with no walkable ground or foot path. Datum (through Aster): please draw skyport ground or a foot path that joins the network. I will then place it at least 200 m from Harbour, on straight beam before the loop. S1 gaps: Gardens to Circus 255 m, Circus to Harbour 237 m.

T1 gaps along the path: 310 m, 308 m and about 435 m. No stop fits in Crown Avenue: the spacing rule needs y 228 or more, but a 30 m straight platform before the R50 corner needs y 224 or less. So Terraces sits on Crown Road at x −90, and the next T1 stop off-sheet must be at x −390 or further west.
T2 gaps by chainage: 321 m, 350 m, 327 m and 305 m. The Market stop is at x 80, outside the Boulevard and Market Street junction, 87 m from T1 Records.
Interchanges, all within 150 m: T1/circus to S1/circus 119 m, T1/records to T2/market 87 m, S1/harbour to T2/parade about 25 m. The three lines connect into one network (N-C1).
N-R1 worst cases by hand, none relying on Skyport: records-square 217 m, docks-east 207 m, docks-south 204 m, crescent-north 193 m, crescent-east 190 m. All are within 250 m.

For Aster, a source conflict: the concept note still describes T1 with an R28 balloon loop and Crown Circus as the only interchange. This proposal follows Datum's run-through T1, which has three interchanges. Open question 2 is still for Sky to decide.
